attempt: Treat a persistent BlockEntity/ModelComponent with BoundingBox and Interactable as automatically hittable by native player attacks.
reason_failed: The user could see/place an object but attacks appeared to hit empty space. The installed Hytale 0.7.2 Interaction.isTargetInvulnerable gate requires EntityStatMap OR RespondToHit; Interactable only makes Use available. The old decoration had neither attackability component.
environment: Windows; Hytale 0.7.2 d769dc3d57881261a62858e1394f0e4de9a21eca; Java 25; Adaptive Surface 0.11.0 user test followed by 0.11.1 native fixtures
error_signature: Native attackable = archetype.contains(EntityStatMap) || archetype.contains(RespondToHit); otherwise target rejected.
workaround: Add and restore RespondToHit and handle native Damage events after filters. Do not add fake health or conflate an entity visual with a functional block. Test native selector eligibility plus removal/refund and block-break protection, then request client acceptance.

source_refs.description: User-reported regressions, native contracts, six isolated boot checks and installation.
